description_zh: 更新数据集成同步任务
name: UpdateDISyncTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the workspace ID. You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。
该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the data synchronization task. Set the value to DI_OFFLINE. You can call the UpdateDISyncTask operation to update only batch synchronization tasks
parameters.help_zh:
修改的数据集成同步任务的任务类型。
目前仅支持使用UpdateDISyncTask接口修改数据集成离线同步任务（DI_OFFLINE）
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The updated configurations of the data synchronization task. Calling this API operation to update a data synchronization task is equivalent to updating a data synchronization task by using the code editor in the DataWorks console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/137717.html. You can call the UpdateDISyncTask operation to update only batch synchronization tasks. If you do not need to update the configurations of the data synchronization task, leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh: 更新已创建的数据集成同步任务通过脚本模式配置的任务内容。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/137717.html。当前仅支持通过UpdateDISyncTask接口更新数据集成离线同步任务。如果您无需更新数据集成同步任务的配置内容，则可将该参数置为空
parameters.name: task_content

parameters.help_en:
The configuration parameters of the data synchronization task. You must configure this parameter in the JSON format.

ResourceGroup: the identifier of the resource group for Data Integration that is used by the data synchronization task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html operation to query the identifier of the resource group.
Cu: the specifications occupied by the data synchronization task in the serverless resource group. The value of this parameter must be a multiple of 0.5
parameters.help_zh:
更新数据集成同步任务的配置参数，使用JSON格式。

ResourceGroup：表示数据集成同步任务所使用的数据集成资源组标识（Identifier）。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html，获取资源组标识。
Cu：表示数据集成同步任务在Serverless资源组上占用的规格，必须是0.5的倍数
parameters.name: task_param

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data synchronization task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 需要更新的数据集成同步任务的任务ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口获取同步任务的ID
parameters.name: file_id

Data.description_en: The information that indicates whether the data synchronization task is updated
Data.description_zh: 更新数据集成同步任务的返回结果

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the data synchronization task fails to be updated. If the data synchronization task is successfully updated, the value null is returned for this parameter
Message.description_zh: 更新数据集成同步任务失败后的原因描述。如果更新数据集成同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Status.description_en:
The update status of the data synchronization task. Valid values:

success
fail
Status.description_zh:
更新数据集成同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：
success：表示更新数据集成同步任务成功。
fail：表示更新数据集成同步任务失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can locate logs and troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
